process.title: Buying process
process.reply:
In short: (1) Sign the sale & purchase agreement (SPA) and complete KYC/AML. (2) Buyer pays a 30% down payment into verified escrow — not a private account. (3) Inspection / due diligence and transfer deed are prepared; remaining funds follow the chosen plan only after approval. (4) When 100% is secured, title is registered under local law; only then does escrow release funds to the seller. Money and title move in that order.

For a clear answer on your case, please speak with your personal broker.

escrow.title: Escrow / funds
escrow.reply:
The purchase price is held by independent escrow (Living Abroad Advisory Centres Limited, also known as FastigheterUtomlands) until conditions are met and title is registered. Escrow does not release funds to the seller before that.

Account details are issued separately by your broker or Finance Manager — never trust payment details sent casually in chat.

For a clear answer on your case, please speak with your personal broker.

payment.title: Payment plans
payment.reply:
Two common models (percentages of the agreed price): Model A — 30% on SPA, then 70% after approved inspection. Model B — 30% on SPA, then 20%, 25%, and 25% on the staged timetable. SEPA / SEPA Instant is the primary method. Crypto only if the contract and escrow schedule expressly allow it.

Exact amounts and account details come only from your broker or Finance Manager for your deal.

For a clear answer on your case, please speak with your personal broker.

kyc.title: KYC / AML
kyc.reply:
Both parties complete KYC/AML (identity, address, and for buyers source of funds for the full price). Escrow may refuse payments until that schedule is approved.

For a clear answer on your documents, please speak with your personal broker.

inspection.title: Inspection / due diligence
inspection.reply:
After the 30% is verified in escrow, an inspection protocol covers legal review, title, mortgages/debts, KYC status and source of funds. Remaining funds move only once the protocol is approved (or agreed actions are signed off).

For a clear answer on your property, please speak with your personal broker.

refund.title: Refund / deposit
refund.reply:
The SPA sets when a down payment can be refunded to the buyer or forfeited to the seller. If there is a dispute, funds stay in escrow until the parties agree or a competent forum decides — escrow does not judge the merits.

This is general information only. For a clear answer on your contract, please speak with your personal broker.

costs.title: Costs and taxes
costs.reply:
Notary, registry and transfer taxes usually follow local practice in the property’s country, unless the SPA records another split. Each party usually bears its own advisory costs.

We do not quote amounts here. For a clear answer on your case, please speak with your personal broker.

land.title: Country / area
land.reply:
Available countries and properties depend on current stock and local rules. Governing law for the SPA is typically the country where the property sits, unless otherwise agreed in writing. Local legal review may be required (for example a Dutch notary for a residential purchase in the Netherlands by a private individual).

For listings and a clear answer for your target area, please speak with your personal broker — or use Book a call.

finans.title: Financing
finans.reply:
Financing options and source-of-funds evidence are deal-specific. Escrow needs approved papers before receiving funds. We do not invent rates or loan terms here.

For a clear answer on financing for your case, please speak with your personal broker.
